title: Python _relay_source_routed lacks preferred-parent/root provenance gating (parity with Rust process_source_route)
description: Robustness/security codereview of project-LICHEN-worker6-xyix: Rust process_source_route (rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/receive.rs:327-339) additionally requires the sender to be the preferred parent and the packet source to be the DODAGID; C enforces equivalent downward-traffic provenance. Python _relay_source_routed (python/src/lichen/node.py) now checks outer-dst-is-self (fixed in xyix) but still relays from any authenticated neighbor without RPL provenance gating. Decide and implement the Python-side policy (incl. behavior when dodag is None).
